ex.en: We were all greatly amused by his jokes.
ex.zh: 他的笑話把我們都逗得很開心。

ex.en: His story amused everyone.
ex.zh: 他的故事把大家都逗笑了。

ex.en: We were all amused with the comedy.
ex.zh: 這齣喜劇讓我們都看得很開心。

ex.en: The kids amused themselves with board games.
ex.zh: 孩子們玩桌遊打發時間。

ex.en: I amused myself by reading magazines at the airport.
ex.zh: 我在機場看雜誌打發時間。

ex.en: She is an ambitious young manager.
ex.zh: 她是一位很有企圖心的年輕經理。

ex.en: Tom is ambitious and works very hard.
ex.zh: 湯姆很有抱負，工作也很努力。

ex.en: That's a very ambitious goal for one year.
ex.zh: 一年內要達成，這個目標很遠大。

ex.en: The company has an ambitious plan to expand into Asia.
ex.zh: 公司有一項進軍亞洲的宏大計畫。

ex.en: We have ample time to catch our train.
ex.zh: 我們有充裕的時間趕上火車。

ex.en: He has ample experience.
ex.zh: 他經驗豐富。

ex.en: There is ample parking near the hotel.
ex.zh: 飯店附近有充足的停車位。

amenity.zh: 便利設施（常用複數 amenities）

ex.en: The hotel offers amenities such as a gym and a pool.
ex.zh: 這家飯店提供健身房和游泳池等設施。

ex.en: The apartment is close to shops and other local amenities.
ex.zh: 這間公寓離商店和其他生活機能都很近。

ex.en: I was still an amateur at that time.
ex.zh: 我那時候還是個外行。

ex.en: My uncle is an amateur cricket player.
ex.zh: 我舅舅是業餘板球選手。

ex.en: This photo was taken by an amateur.
ex.zh: 這張照片是業餘攝影者拍的。

ex.en: He was appointed ambassador to Britain.
ex.zh: 他被任命為駐英大使。

ex.en: I have spoken with the Polish ambassador.
ex.zh: 我和波蘭大使談過了。

ex.en: The actress is the brand's new ambassador.
ex.zh: 這位女演員是這個品牌的新代言人。

ex.en: The company hired a famous athlete as its ambassador.
ex.zh: 公司請了一位知名運動員擔任品牌大使。

ex.en: He has ambition, so he works hard.
ex.zh: 他有抱負，所以很努力工作。

ex.en: Mary wanted to marry a man with ambition.
ex.zh: 瑪麗想嫁給一個有抱負的男人。

ex.en: He was a man of great ambition.
ex.zh: 他是個雄心勃勃的人。

ex.en: I am not without my shortcomings, but these shortcomings can easily be amended.
ex.zh: 我不是沒有缺點，但這些缺點很容易改正。

ex.en: We need to amend the contract.
ex.zh: 我們需要修改合約。

ex.en: The law was amended last year.
ex.zh: 這條法律去年修訂了。

ex.en: It's never too late to make amends.
ex.zh: 彌補永遠不嫌晚。

ex.en: He tried to make amends for his mistake.
ex.zh: 他試著彌補自己的錯誤。

ex.en: The loan has a 20-year amortization period.
ex.zh: 這筆貸款的分期償還期為二十年。

ex.en: Amortization spreads the cost over several years.
ex.zh: 攤銷是把成本分攤到好幾年。

ex.en: The cost of the equipment is amortized over five years.
ex.zh: 設備成本分五年攤銷。

ex.en: We amortize the loan with monthly payments.
ex.zh: 我們每月分期償還這筆貸款。

ex.en: Compiling a dictionary demands an enormous amount of time.
ex.zh: 編字典需要耗費大量時間。

ex.en: He would be paid a small amount of money.
ex.zh: 他會拿到一小筆錢。

ex.en: Please enter the amount you want to transfer.
ex.zh: 請輸入您要轉帳的金額。

ex.en: The bill amounted to 100 dollars.
ex.zh: 帳單總計一百美元。

ex.en: The loss amounts to a million dollars.
ex.zh: 損失高達一百萬美元。

ex.en: He amazed everyone by passing his driving test.
ex.zh: 他通過了駕照考試，讓大家都很驚訝。

ex.en: His memory amazes me.
ex.zh: 他的記憶力讓我很驚訝。

ex.en: We're amazed by the rapid growth in import quantities.
ex.zh: 進口量的快速成長讓我們很驚訝。

ex.en: This week has been an amazing experience.
ex.zh: 這週的經歷真的太棒了。

ex.en: The view from the top is amazing.
ex.zh: 從山頂看出去的景色太美了。

ex.en: The contract requires an amendment before we sign it.
ex.zh: 合約在簽署前需要修訂。

ex.en: Parliament passed an amendment to the tax law.
ex.zh: 國會通過了稅法修正案。

ex.en: Please send me the amendments by Friday.
ex.zh: 請在星期五前把修改的部分寄給我。

amino.zh: 胺基的（常用 amino acid 胺基酸）

ex.en: Proteins are made of amino acids.
ex.zh: 蛋白質由胺基酸組成。

ex.en: Eggs contain all the essential amino acids.
ex.zh: 雞蛋含有所有必需胺基酸。

ex.en: Scientists measured the amplitude of the sound wave.
ex.zh: 科學家測量了聲波的振幅。

ex.en: Higher amplitude means a louder sound.
ex.zh: 振幅越大，聲音越大。

ex.en: I feel ambivalent about moving to a new city.
ex.zh: 對於搬到新城市，我的心情很矛盾。

ex.en: She was ambivalent about the job offer.
ex.zh: 對於這份工作邀約，她拿不定主意。

ex.en: Soft lighting gives the restaurant a relaxed ambience.
ex.zh: 柔和燈光讓餐廳氣氛十分放鬆。

ex.en: The hotel"s quiet ambience suits guests seeking a retreat.
ex.zh: 這間飯店安靜的氛圍很適合想放鬆休息的客人。

ex.en: The hotel has excellent amenities, including a gym and a pool.
ex.zh: 這家飯店設施很好，有健身房和游泳池。

ex.en: The apartment is close to local amenities like shops and parks.
ex.zh: 這間公寓靠近商店、公園等生活機能。

ex.en: Call an ambulance.
ex.zh: 叫救護車。

ex.en: The ambulances carried the injured to the nearest hospital.
ex.zh: 救護車把傷者送往了最近的醫院。

ex.en: Hang on. The ambulance will get here in just a little bit.
ex.zh: 撐著點，救護車馬上就到。
